packageRules.description: odysseus is a locally-built image (no registry repo) — Renovate can't look it up, which raises a permanent 'Package lookup failures' WARN on the Dependency Dashboard. Disable tracking for it (docker datasource, package name 'odysseus'); the other images in that compose file still resolve normally.
Authentik: chart version and container image move together upstream. Group them in one PR so ArgoCD never sees a chart/image schema mismatch.
Auto-merge patches across the repo (image-updater already covers most patch bumps; Renovate picks up anything image-updater misses, e.g. chart-only patches).
Authentik MINOR/MAJOR: never auto-merge — release notes can carry DB migrations and breaking changes. PR opens, you review, you click merge.
Self-hosted Renovate image: cut noise — suppress minor+patch (no branch/PR). Only major updates remain, so a branch on this image always signals a major.
Self-hosted Renovate image: major updates open a PR on renovate/<image>-<newMajor>.x for manual review — never auto-merge.

customManagers.description: Keep the pinned helm + kustomize versions in ci.yml (the secret-free validate gate's Install tools step) fresh. Markers are inline trailing comments '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' on each KUSTOMIZE_VERSION=/HELM_VERSION= line.
